articles.title: Guardians’ potential playoff opponents set as Astros win AL West, will host White Sox in wild card round
articles.description: The Guardians, holding the No. 2 seed and a first-round bye, await the winner of the Astros-White Sox Wild Card Series to determine their ALDS opponent starting Saturday at Progressive Field.

articles.title: Guardians clinch AL Central title with 11-5 win over Royals and White Sox’s loss to Rockies
articles.description: The Guardians victory combined with a White Sox’s 9-6 loss to the Rockies on Saturday night in Chicago gave Cleveland its third consecutive AL Central title.

articles.title: Parker Messick makes final start before ALDS as Guardians lose season finale 3-2 to Royals
articles.description: Rookie left-hander Parker Messick started but only went three innings in his final tuneup before the Guardians open the best-of-five American League Division Series on Saturday at Progressive Field.

articles.title: Austin Hedges says Guardians’ AL Central title was worth the grind: ‘We’re not done’
articles.description: The Guardians clinched their fourth AL Central title in five years, and Austin Hedges says Cleveland’s difficult road made the celebration even sweeter.

articles.title: Guardians recall rookie right-hander on last day of regular season to backup Parker Messick
articles.description: Guardians recalled right-hander, who may relieve lefty Parker Messick after he starts against Kansas City in Sunday's regular season finale.

articles.title: After a season of bad breaks, Tanner Bibee delivers when Guardians need him most
articles.description: Tanner Bibee recovered from a three-run first inning to deliver six strong innings in the Guardians’ must-win game against Kansas City.

articles.title: Stephen Vogt credits Guardians’ depth after third straight AL Central title
articles.description: Stephen Vogt credits the Guardians’ roster depth for carrying Cleveland through injuries and to its third straight AL Central championship.

articles.title: ‘It feels like home’: Jo Adell celebrates first postseason trip with Guardians
articles.description: After parts of seven seasons without reaching the playoffs, Jo Adell finally got his champagne celebration as the Guardians clinched a postseason spot at Fenway Park.

articles.description: The Guardians used a five-run ninth inning to beat the Royals and retain their hold on first place in the AL Central with two games to play.
